confirmed_facts: Centralized retail finance. Each unit actually has associated bank accounts, but only HO staff can view/access/operate bank accounts; unit staff cannot. HO also has its own accounts.
Units handle physical sales cash, petty cash and cashier float. No direct unit-to-unit transactions.
After stripping E1 location suffix, baseline is 499 account families, including six non-E1 leaves.
We are evaluating ONLY removing bank institution/account identity within the 14 listed bank/deposit families. All other 485 families remain unchanged.
No transaction balances, actual account numbers, deposit maturities, restrictions, legal entity ownership or bank master provided. COA repetitions do not establish actual bank accounts.

state.scope: Propose bank_account_id master with associated_unit_id and HO-only access. Do not assume centralized access means every bank account belongs to HO. Do not force total chart to 38 or 45.

bank_unit_model.instructions: How should bank association and access be represented given the confirmed facts?

criteria.unit_association_ho_access: Each bank master retains associated unit; HO-only role permissions govern access separately.
criteria.all_ho: Associate all bank accounts only with HO because HO controls access.
criteria.unit_access: Give associated units bank access automatically.

merge_institution.instructions: For the five Giro accounts, is removing bank institution identity reasonable provided each actual bank account retains its own balance and reconciliation?

criteria.merge: One Giro GL account plus mandatory bank_account_id.
criteria.insufficient: Insufficient evidence even for this conditional design.

savings.instructions: For the five Tabungan families, choose treatment preserving individual bank reconciliation.

deposits.instructions: For four Time Deposit institution families, which provisional handling avoids assuming maturity and restriction classifications?

criteria.conditional: One provisional deposito family with instrument-level records; validate maturity/restriction/reporting before final classification.
criteria.cash: Merge every deposit into cash equivalents immediately.
criteria.retain: Keep institution-specific GL solely because banks differ.

phase_one_count.instructions: Which first-stage chart preserves Giro, Tabungan and Time Deposit distinctions while removing only bank institution identity from listed families?

criteria.487: 499 minus 14 plus 2 = 487; also merge Giro and Tabungan.

criteria.real_account: Actual bank account/instrument identifier, not just bank name or unit.

payment_attribution.instructions: HO pays an expense for C002 from a bank account associated with C001. Without asserting this payment is allowed, which design handles the distinction if policy permits it?

criteria.separate: Bank posting derives cash attribution from bank master; expense unit comes from document/allocation; validate balancing policy.
criteria.same: Always infer expense unit from paying bank regardless of beneficiary.
criteria.ho: Always set every journal unit to HO.

cost_center.instructions: Does bank association with a unit automatically establish the cost center for all expenses paid from that account?

criteria.no: No; funding account association and expense beneficiary can differ.
